question: Which of the following Articles is associated with the establishment and constitution of Supreme Court?
solution:
The correct answer is __**124**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 124:**

 
 
• **​**The Supreme Court of India should be composed of the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of India, and the number of other Supreme Judges shall not exceed seven before the increase in the number of members is passed by the Parliament. Each judge of the Supreme Court shall be appointed by the President.
